responses.reason: Pausing the stopwatch should hold the clock-divider count and prevent counter increments while start_stop is low.
responses.spec_quote: Start/stop is a 1 bit control signal that controls if the stopwatch is running or paused.

responses.reason: The seconds counters should update on the same active edge that the divider reaches CLK_FREQ-1, not one cycle later.
responses.spec_quote: The clock divider within the module uses this parameter to generate a one-second pulse (`one_sec_pulse`).
